name: Sono Yoru wa Doro no Naka
source:
The ordinary office worker Azami gets harassed by a drunkard on the way home from a company drinking party.  
A stranger comes to his rescue but, in return, asks to stay at Azami's place.  
Too weary to refuse, Azami reluctantly agrees—and so begins their strange life under the same roof.
translation:
普通上班族阿扎米在公司酒会回家的路上遭到酒鬼的骚扰。
一名陌生人来救他，但作为回报，他要求留在阿扎美的住处。
阿扎美无力拒绝，无奈地同意了——于是，他们在同一屋檐下开始了奇怪的生活。
